The '''Contruum system''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and was a dense system of inhabited worlds, among them [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and [[Contruum Six]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The preview of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' published in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'' used [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] and the "Bogden sector" for a scene, but they were replaced by [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and the Contruum system in the final version.
